edition.title: The World in Brief · Contextual Cloze · 26 November 2026
edition.summary_zh: 按11月26日订阅邮件七则短讯顺序原创改写，共21空，重点练习逻辑区分、新闻措辞和写作搭配。
edition.source_label: The Economist · 订阅邮件学习版

items.example: The White House mooted tariff rates of 15% to 40%, putting them forward for discussion rather than announcing that importers already owed them.
items.cloze: The White House ______ tariff rates of 15% to 40%, putting them forward for discussion rather than announcing that importers already owed them.
items.analysis_zh: moot a proposal 在这里是提出一个方案供讨论，并不表示立刻执行。后半句 putting them forward for discussion 给出线索。留意 moot 在 a moot point 中是形容词，语义不同；此处是过去式动词。
items.why_zh: moot a proposal 在这里是提出一个方案供讨论，并不表示立刻执行。后半句 putting them forward for discussion 给出线索。

imitation.sentence_en: We mooted a fixed ordering cycle before asking the distributor to commit.
imitation.translation_zh: 我们先提出固定订货周期供讨论，再请经销商作出承诺。

context.en: The White House mooted tariff rates of 15% to 40%, putting them forward for discussion rather than announcing that importers already owed them.
context.zh: 白宫提出了15%至40%的关税税率供讨论，并未宣布进口商已经需要缴纳。

items.example: Trade practices across 16 economies came under official scrutiny, with investigators examining issues such as subsidies and currency policy.
items.cloze: Trade practices across 16 economies came under official ______, with investigators examining issues such as subsidies and currency policy.
items.analysis_zh: come under scrutiny 是进入被仔细检查的状态，不等于被处罚。investigators examining 是线索；under 后面要接名词，scrutiny 强调持续、细致地审视，不是一次简单的查看。
items.why_zh: come under scrutiny 是进入被仔细检查的状态，不等于被处罚。investigators examining 是线索；under 后面要接名词，scrutiny 强调持续、细致地审视，不是一次简单的查看。

imitation.sentence_en: The assumptions behind the freight estimate came under scrutiny during the review.
imitation.translation_zh: 评审时，运费估算背后的假设受到仔细审查。

context.en: Trade practices across 16 economies came under official scrutiny, with investigators examining issues such as subsidies and currency policy.
context.zh: 16个经济体的贸易做法受到官方审查，调查人员检查补贴和汇率政策等问题。

items.example: The trade office signalled that it would factor existing agreements and duties into the calculation, rather than treating them as irrelevant to the final rates.
items.cloze: The trade office signalled that it would ______ existing agreements and duties into the calculation, rather than treating them as irrelevant to the final rates.
items.analysis_zh: factor A into B 是把 A 当成影响 B 的变量，而不是把 A 从 B 中剔除。句中 into the calculation 限定了结构，rather than 后面说明现有安排并非无关。也可说 incorporate A into B。
items.why_zh: factor A into B 是把 A 当成影响 B 的变量，而不是把 A 从 B 中剔除。句中 into the calculation 限定了结构，rather than 后面说明现有安排并非无关。

imitation.sentence_en: We need to factor inventory holding costs into the comparison.
imitation.translation_zh: 我们需要把库存持有成本纳入比较。

context.en: The trade office signalled that it would factor existing agreements and duties into the calculation, rather than treating them as irrelevant to the final rates.
context.zh: 贸易办公室表示会把现行协议和关税纳入计算，不会把它们视为与最终税率无关。

items.example: After Jensen Huang returned as chief executive, S&P put Nvidia on watch for a possible downgrade, explicitly warning that it could lower rather than raise the company's AA credit rating.
items.cloze: After Jensen Huang returned as chief executive, S&P put Nvidia on watch for a possible ______, explicitly warning that it could lower rather than raise the company's AA credit rating.
items.analysis_zh: 信用评级有上调和下调两种方向，后半句 lower rather than raise 把方向锁定。possible downgrade 是可能下调，watch 不是已下调，不能把信用观察写成评级已变。
items.why_zh: 信用评级有上调和下调两种方向，后半句 lower rather than raise 把方向锁定。possible downgrade 是可能下调，watch 不是已下调，不能把信用观察写成评级已变。

imitation.sentence_en: A possible downgrade does not change the supplier's current rating.
imitation.translation_zh: 可能下调评级不等于供应商目前的评级已变。

context.en: After Jensen Huang returned as chief executive, S&P put Nvidia on watch for a possible downgrade, explicitly warning that it could lower rather than raise the company's AA credit rating.
context.zh: 黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官后，标普把英伟达列入可能下调评级的观察名单，警告其 AA 评级可能降低而非提高。

items.example: The agency said long board tenures may have compromised directors' independence, raising doubts about how freely they could challenge management.
items.cloze: The agency said long board tenures may have ______ directors' independence, raising doubts about how freely they could challenge management.
items.analysis_zh: compromise independence 指独立性被削弱，并非董事作出了折中。may have 加过去分词，把它限定为对既有情况的可能判断；raising doubts 给出负面方向，但不是认定。
items.why_zh: compromise independence 指独立性被削弱，并非董事作出了折中。may have 加过去分词，把它限定为对既有情况的可能判断；raising doubts 给出负面方向，但不是认定。

imitation.sentence_en: Using the same reviewer for both stages could compromise the independence of the second check.
imitation.translation_zh: 两个阶段都让同一个人审核，可能影响第二次核查的独立性。

context.en: The agency said long board tenures may have compromised directors' independence, raising doubts about how freely they could challenge management.
context.zh: 评级机构称董事任职时间过长可能损害其独立性，使人质疑他们能否自由挑战管理层。

items.example: The AA rating remained intact: the watch notice flagged a risk to the existing grade without changing it.
items.cloze: The AA rating remained ______: the watch notice flagged a risk to the existing grade without changing it.
items.analysis_zh: remain intact 常见于说明某个成果或状态经历压力后仍完好。冒号后 without changing it 明确现状没有变化。intact 不意味着未来没有风险，这里要与 watch 同时理解。
items.why_zh: remain intact 常见于说明某个成果或状态经历压力后仍完好。冒号后 without changing it 明确现状没有变化。

imitation.sentence_en: The interface changed, but all saved records remained intact.
imitation.translation_zh: 界面变了，但所有已保存记录都完好无损。

context.en: The AA rating remained intact: the watch notice flagged a risk to the existing grade without changing it.
context.zh: AA 评级维持不变：观察通知提示现有评级面临风险，并未改变评级。

items.example: The US communications regulator cleared SpaceX to pursue a satellite network for orbital computing, giving the company formal permission subject to conditions.
items.cloze: The US communications regulator ______ SpaceX to pursue a satellite network for orbital computing, giving the company formal permission subject to conditions.
items.analysis_zh: clear someone to do something 在监管文中指准许做某事，不是清理某物。giving formal permission 表明这是授权，不是一般鼓励。后面的条件约束授权，但不把动作改成拒绝。
items.why_zh: clear someone to do something 在监管文中指准许做某事，不是清理某物。giving formal permission 表明这是授权，不是一般鼓励。

imitation.sentence_en: Quality cleared the team to run the pilot after reviewing the test plan.
imitation.translation_zh: 质量部门审核测试计划后，批准团队开展试产。

context.en: The US communications regulator cleared SpaceX to pursue a satellite network for orbital computing, giving the company formal permission subject to conditions.
context.zh: 美国通信监管机构批准 SpaceX 推进用于轨道计算的卫星网络，正式许可附有条件。

items.example: That decision was not tantamount to putting satellites in orbit: a regulatory green light is not the same as a launch.
items.cloze: That decision was not ______ to putting satellites in orbit: a regulatory green light is not the same as a launch.
items.analysis_zh: tantamount to 指结果或实质上相当于，后接名词或动名词。冒号后 not the same as 是释义，not 划出许可与实物发射的边界。这个词不用于单纯说明时间先后。
items.why_zh: tantamount to 指结果或实质上相当于，后接名词或动名词。冒号后 not the same as 是释义，not 划出许可与实物发射的边界。

imitation.sentence_en: Signing the framework is not tantamount to placing a purchase order.
imitation.translation_zh: 签署框架协议不等于正式下达采购订单。

context.en: That decision was not tantamount to putting satellites in orbit: a regulatory green light is not the same as a launch.
context.zh: 该决定并不等同于把卫星送入轨道：监管放行不等于真的完成发射。

items.example: Building computing capacity in orbit would entail substantial expense; getting permission does not eliminate the cost of building the system.
items.cloze: Building computing capacity in orbit would ______ substantial expense; getting permission does not eliminate the cost of building the system.
items.analysis_zh: entail 强调某项决定或工程必然带来的成本、义务或后果。expense 与后句 cost 互相照应，would 表明是在估计尚未实施的项目，不是说成本已经发生。
items.why_zh: entail 强调某项决定或工程必然带来的成本、义务或后果。expense 与后句 cost 互相照应，would 表明是在估计尚未实施的项目，不是说成本已经发生。

imitation.sentence_en: Changing the production site would entail new validation work.
imitation.translation_zh: 更换生产地址将意味着要做新的验证工作。

context.en: Building computing capacity in orbit would entail substantial expense; getting permission does not eliminate the cost of building the system.
context.zh: 在轨道上建设计算能力将涉及可观开支；拿到许可并不会消除建造系统的成本。

items.example: The Office for National Statistics put net migration at 77,000 in the year to June; the estimate is provisional and can be revised as better data arrive.
items.cloze: The Office for National Statistics put net migration at 77,000 in the year to June; the estimate is ______ and can be revised as better data arrive.
items.analysis_zh: provisional 不只是大概，而是尚未最终确定、可随资料更新而修订。线索是后面 can be revised。preliminary 可以表达初步，final 和句中明确的后续修订方向相反。
items.why_zh: provisional 不只是大概，而是尚未最终确定、可随资料更新而修订。线索是后面 can be revised。

imitation.sentence_en: The month-end inventory figure is provisional until all sites report.
imitation.translation_zh: 各工厂还没报齐，月末库存数字暂未最终确定。

context.en: The Office for National Statistics put net migration at 77,000 in the year to June; the estimate is provisional and can be revised as better data arrive.
context.zh: 英国国家统计局估计截至6月的一年净移民为7.7万人，数字暂未最终确定，数据完善后可修订。

items.example: Much of the decline stemmed from fewer arrivals from outside the European Union, which the data identify as a major driver of the overall change.
items.cloze: Much of the decline ______ from fewer arrivals from outside the European Union, which the data identify as a major driver of the overall change.
items.analysis_zh: stem from 指某个结果的来源，不能把原因和结果的主语倒过来。句中主语是 decline，from 后是非欧盟抵达人数减少；后半句 major driver 强化这种因果关系。
items.why_zh: stem from 指某个结果的来源，不能把原因和结果的主语倒过来。句中主语是 decline，from 后是非欧盟抵达人数减少；后半句 major driver 强化这种因果关系。

imitation.sentence_en: The delay stemmed from a shortage of qualified packaging materials.
imitation.translation_zh: 延期源于合格包材短缺。

context.en: Much of the decline stemmed from fewer arrivals from outside the European Union, which the data identify as a major driver of the overall change.
context.zh: 整体降幅很大一部分源于来自欧盟以外的抵达人数减少，数据将这一变化列为主要原因。

items.example: The home secretary presented the figure as a vindication of Labour's approach, treating it as evidence that the government's policy had been right.
items.cloze: The home secretary presented the figure as a ______ of Labour's approach, treating it as evidence that the government's policy had been right.
items.analysis_zh: vindication of 表示某个结果被当作证明先前判断或做法没有错；逗号后的 treating it as evidence 把这个含义说清了。presented as 表明这是官员给出的解读，不等于统计机构证明了政策因果。
items.why_zh: vindication of 表示某个结果被当作证明先前判断或做法没有错；逗号后的 treating it as evidence 把这个含义说清了。presented as 表明这是官员给出的解读，不等于统计机构证明了政策因果。

imitation.sentence_en: The manager saw the fall in shortages as a vindication of the buffer-stock policy.
imitation.translation_zh: 经理认为缺货减少说明缓冲库存政策是对的。

context.en: The home secretary presented the figure as a vindication of Labour's approach, treating it as evidence that the government's policy had been right.
context.zh: 内政大臣把这一数字描述为工党做法正确的证明，把它当作政府政策有效的证据。

items.example: The three judges presiding over Binyamin Netanyahu's corruption trial are overseeing the proceedings, not acting as prosecutors.
items.cloze: The three judges ______ over Binyamin Netanyahu's corruption trial are overseeing the proceedings, not acting as prosecutors.
items.analysis_zh: preside over 在司法语境中指主持审理，而非发起起诉。are overseeing 对角色给了直白线索。presiding over 短语修饰 judges；它把审理者与检方的职能分开。
items.why_zh: preside over 在司法语境中指主持审理，而非发起起诉。are overseeing 对角色给了直白线索。

imitation.sentence_en: The director presiding over the review will not present the supplier's case.
imitation.translation_zh: 主持评审的总监不会代供应商陈述其情况。

context.en: The three judges presiding over Binyamin Netanyahu's corruption trial are overseeing the proceedings, not acting as prosecutors.
context.zh: 主持审理内塔尼亚胡腐败案的三名法官负责掌管审理程序，不是检察官。

items.example: The panel urged prosecutors to withdraw some charges from the case because it doubted that a bribery conviction could be secured.
items.cloze: The panel urged prosecutors to ______ some charges from the case because it doubted that a bribery conviction could be secured.
items.analysis_zh: withdraw charges 指检方把已经提出的指控收回，不是法院撤销原判。from the case 以及法官怀疑定罪可能性提供线索。urge 后接人和不定式，本身也表明只是建议采取行动。
items.why_zh: withdraw charges 指检方把已经提出的指控收回，不是法院撤销原判。from the case 以及法官怀疑定罪可能性提供线索。

imitation.sentence_en: We asked the supplier to withdraw the surcharge from the revised quotation.
imitation.translation_zh: 我们请供应商把附加费从修订报价中撤掉。

context.en: The panel urged prosecutors to withdraw some charges from the case because it doubted that a bribery conviction could be secured.
context.zh: 法官小组敦促检方撤回部分指控，因为他们怀疑贿赂罪能否被判成立。

items.example: The judges' assessment was not an acquittal; it did not formally clear Netanyahu of any charge.
items.cloze: The judges' assessment was not an ______; it did not formally clear Netanyahu of any charge.
items.analysis_zh: acquittal 是法庭作出的无罪判决，不能等同于法官对定罪难度的看法。后半句 did not formally clear 提示这里考的是正式法律结果而非非正式意见；也不是对已判罪的赦免。
items.why_zh: acquittal 是法庭作出的无罪判决，不能等同于法官对定罪难度的看法。后半句 did not formally clear 提示这里考的是正式法律结果而非非正式意见；也不是对已判罪的赦免。

imitation.background_zh: 理解新闻里的司法阶段
imitation.sentence_en: The counsel stressed that an acquittal was a court ruling, not a withdrawal by prosecutors.
imitation.translation_zh: 律师强调，无罪判决是法院裁定，不是检方撤回指控。

context.en: The judges' assessment was not an acquittal; it did not formally clear Netanyahu of any charge.
context.zh: 法官的评估不是无罪裁决，并未正式判定内塔尼亚胡任何一项罪名不成立。

items.example: Initial accounts traced the fire to a petrol tanker that had tipped over in a tunnel on Cairo's ring road.
items.cloze: Initial accounts ______ the fire to a petrol tanker that had tipped over in a tunnel on Cairo's ring road.
items.analysis_zh: trace A to B 表示顺着线索把事件追溯到某个来源，A 是火灾，B 是翻倒的油罐车。Initial accounts 保留这是初步说法，不是已有最终调查结论。attribute 常强调归因，trace 更突出追查来源。
items.why_zh: trace A to B 表示顺着线索把事件追溯到某个来源，A 是火灾，B 是翻倒的油罐车。Initial accounts 保留这是初步说法，不是已有最终调查结论。

imitation.sentence_en: The investigation traced the variation to a change in mixing time.
imitation.translation_zh: 调查将波动追溯到混合时间改变。

context.en: Initial accounts traced the fire to a petrol tanker that had tipped over in a tunnel on Cairo's ring road.
context.zh: 初步报道把火灾追溯到在开罗环路一处隧道翻倒的油罐车。

items.example: The blaze was later extinguished, with no flames left burning.
items.cloze: The blaze was later ______, with no flames left burning.
items.analysis_zh: extinguish 用于把火完全扑灭，后面的 no flames left burning 明确说火已灭。contain a blaze 只是控制它不再蔓延，不能据此断定灭火结束。这里用被动，把焦点放在火势结果。
items.why_zh: extinguish 用于把火完全扑灭，后面的 no flames left burning 明确说火已灭。contain a blaze 只是控制它不再蔓延，不能据此断定灭火结束。

imitation.sentence_en: The crew contained the fire in ten minutes but did not extinguish it for another hour.
imitation.translation_zh: 消防人员十分钟内控制了火势，但又过了一小时才把火扑灭。

context.en: The blaze was later extinguished, with no flames left burning.
context.zh: 大火随后被扑灭，已没有火焰继续燃烧。

items.example: President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi offered his condolences to those mourning the dead.
items.cloze: President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi offered his ______ to those mourning the dead.
items.analysis_zh: offer one's condolences to 是对死者亲友致哀的固定搭配，condolences 通常用复数。mourning the dead 把语境限定为丧亲；sympathy 范围更广，也可用于生病或其他遭遇。
items.why_zh: offer one's condolences to 是对死者亲友致哀的固定搭配，condolences 通常用复数。mourning the dead 把语境限定为丧亲；sympathy 范围更广，也可用于生病或其他遭遇。

imitation.sentence_en: The team offered its condolences to the families affected by the accident.
imitation.translation_zh: 团队向事故遇难者的家属表达了慰问。

context.en: President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi offered his condolences to those mourning the dead.
context.zh: 总统塞西向哀悼罹难者的人们表达慰问。

items.example: An approaching storm threw plans for the Macy's Thanksgiving parade into disarray, forcing New York to abandon the original date.
items.cloze: An approaching storm threw plans for the Macy's Thanksgiving parade into ______, forcing New York to abandon the original date.
items.analysis_zh: throw something into disarray 表示原本有序的安排突然被打乱。forcing 后面给出了实际后果：原定日期无法使用。与仅仅 create uncertainty 不同，原有计划已经无法照常执行。
items.why_zh: throw something into disarray 表示原本有序的安排突然被打乱。forcing 后面给出了实际后果：原定日期无法使用。

imitation.sentence_en: The port closure threw our delivery schedule into disarray.
imitation.translation_zh: 港口关闭打乱了原定交货计划。

context.en: An approaching storm threw plans for the Macy's Thanksgiving parade into disarray, forcing New York to abandon the original date.
context.zh: 一场将至的风暴打乱了梅西感恩节游行的计划，纽约不得不放弃原定日期。

items.example: Organisers deferred the event until Saturday rather than cancelling it outright.
items.cloze: Organisers ______ the event until Saturday rather than cancelling it outright.
items.analysis_zh: defer A until B 表示把 A 推到 B 时执行。until Saturday 清楚给了替代日期，后面的 rather than cancelling 明确排除取消；defer 比 put off 更正式。
items.why_zh: defer A until B 表示把 A 推到 B 时执行。until Saturday 清楚给了替代日期，后面的 rather than cancelling 明确排除取消；defer 比 put off 更正式。

imitation.sentence_en: We deferred the factory audit until the new line was ready.
imitation.translation_zh: 我们把工厂审核推迟到新产线准备就绪之后。

context.en: Organisers deferred the event until Saturday rather than cancelling it outright.
context.zh: 主办方把活动推迟到周六，没有直接取消。

items.example: During the Second World War, organisers stopped holding the parade to conserve materials that were needed elsewhere.
items.cloze: During the Second World War, organisers stopped holding the parade to ______ materials that were needed elsewhere.
items.analysis_zh: conserve materials 表示在资源紧张时减少消耗、把物资留给别处。needed elsewhere 是线索。preserve 有保护物品不受损的意思，在这句也可以理解为保存材料供他用。
items.why_zh: conserve materials 表示在资源紧张时减少消耗、把物资留给别处。needed elsewhere 是线索。

imitation.sentence_en: We combined test runs to conserve the remaining packaging stock.
imitation.translation_zh: 我们合并安排了试验批，以节约剩余包材。

context.en: During the Second World War, organisers stopped holding the parade to conserve materials that were needed elsewhere.
context.zh: 二战期间，主办方停办游行，把材料省下来供别处使用。

passages.title: Washington outlines new import duties
passages.body: The White House {{2026-11-26-tariffs-mooted}} tariff rates of 15% to 40%, putting them forward for discussion rather than announcing that importers already owed them. Trade practices across 16 economies came under official {{2026-11-26-tariffs-scrutiny}}, with investigators examining issues such as subsidies and currency policy. The trade office signalled that it would {{2026-11-26-tariffs-factor}} existing agreements and duties into the calculation, rather than treating them as irrelevant to the final rates.

passages.title: A chipmaker faces closer oversight
passages.body: After Jensen Huang returned as chief executive, S&P put Nvidia on watch for a possible {{2026-11-26-nvidia-downgrade}}, explicitly warning that it could lower rather than raise the company's AA credit rating. The agency said long board tenures may have {{2026-11-26-nvidia-compromised}} directors' independence, raising doubts about how freely they could challenge management. The AA rating remained {{2026-11-26-nvidia-intact}}: the watch notice flagged a risk to the existing grade without changing it.

passages.title: US regulators take a step on orbital computing
passages.body: The US communications regulator {{2026-11-26-spacex-cleared}} SpaceX to pursue a satellite network for orbital computing, giving the company formal permission subject to conditions. That decision was not {{2026-11-26-spacex-tantamount}} to putting satellites in orbit: a regulatory green light is not the same as a launch. Building computing capacity in orbit would {{2026-11-26-spacex-entail}} substantial expense; getting permission does not eliminate the cost of building the system.

passages.title: Britain records fewer net arrivals
passages.body: The Office for National Statistics put net migration at 77,000 in the year to June; the estimate is {{2026-11-26-uk-provisional}} and can be revised as better data arrive. Much of the decline {{2026-11-26-uk-stemmed}} from fewer arrivals from outside the European Union, which the data identify as a major driver of the overall change. The home secretary presented the figure as a {{2026-11-26-uk-vindication}} of Labour's approach, treating it as evidence that the government's policy had been right.

passages.title: Israeli judges question the strength of a case
passages.body: The three judges {{2026-11-26-netanyahu-presiding}} over Binyamin Netanyahu's corruption trial are overseeing the proceedings, not acting as prosecutors. The panel urged prosecutors to {{2026-11-26-netanyahu-withdraw}} some charges from the case because it doubted that a bribery conviction could be secured. The judges' assessment was not an {{2026-11-26-netanyahu-acquittal}}; it did not formally clear Netanyahu of any charge.

passages.title: A tanker accident turns deadly near Cairo
passages.body: Initial accounts {{2026-11-26-cairo-traced}} the fire to a petrol tanker that had tipped over in a tunnel on Cairo's ring road. The blaze was later {{2026-11-26-cairo-extinguished}}, with no flames left burning. President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi offered his {{2026-11-26-cairo-condolences}} to those mourning the dead. Egypt's health ministry reported that the fire had killed and injured dozens of people.

passages.title: New York changes its Thanksgiving weekend plans
passages.body: An approaching storm threw plans for the Macy's Thanksgiving parade into {{2026-11-26-parade-disarray}}, forcing New York to abandon the original date. Organisers {{2026-11-26-parade-deferred}} the event until Saturday rather than cancelling it outright. During the Second World War, organisers stopped holding the parade to {{2026-11-26-parade-conserve}} materials that were needed elsewhere.
